site_audit.platform: WordPress, Astra theme, Elementor 4.3.2 + Elementor Pro 3.34.0 (post IDs 36 and 1586), Swiper 8.4.5, Site Kit by Google, Elementor Pro mega-menu / sticky / icon-list / slides / call-to-action widgets, plus a script and CSS optimiser that rewrites the markup with bv-* attributes
site_audit.html_errors: 298 errors (294 HTML), 47 warnings, 101 info on the homepage - the highest error count in this audit. The dominant cause is the site's own script and CSS optimiser, which rewrites the served markup and leaves 70 illegal bv-* attributes, 16 scripts with type="bv_inline_delayed_js", 10 style elements with a non-text/css type, 32 style rules outside an @scope rule and 46 duplicate IDs. The same optimiser breaks the images: 29 elements are missing both src and srcset and 5 more carry sizes without srcset, so they cannot load at all. Also present: 6 inputs with an empty min/max, 2 required selects with no placeholder option, 10 element-in-element nesting errors, 6 summary elements missing aria-checked/aria-level/role, 6 aria-expanded on a summary for its parent details, 2 CSS parse errors and 2 heading-level skips (h1 to h3, h2 to h4).

issues: Your years-in-business figure contradicts itself three times on one page: 'Since 2015' (11 years in 2026), then '10+ Years of Experience', then '15+ Years Solar Experience' a few lines further down.

Three of your four service cards point at the wrong page. 'Solar EPC 03' and 'Operations and Maintenance 04' both link to /consultancy-advisory/, while the slider directly above the same block links correctly to /epc-services/ and /operations-maintenance/. The two blocks disagree with each other.
The optimiser on your site is breaking your own images: the checker reports 29 elements missing both src and srcset, and 5 more carrying sizes without srcset. Those images cannot load at all.
og:site_name is set to "Home" instead of SunWorks Energy, so every share of your homepage is attributed to a page called 'Home'.
The checker reports 298 errors and 47 warnings on the homepage - the highest error count in this audit - and 46 of them are duplicate IDs.

site_evidence.note: Read on 2026-11-10. The <head> script tags of this page were not returned in readable form, so tracking-tag presence is unknown in both directions and is reported as not checked rather than as absent. Confirmed in the head: no Meta Pixel, GA4, GTM or Google Ads tag confirmed. Every other check on this page - the title, the meta description, the Open Graph tags, the plugin stack, the validator counts and all content checks - was measured.

promise_gap: Google Ads Transparency: 1 live ad under advertiser AR07942131426432909313, verified as SUNWORKS ENERGY PRIVATE LIMITED.

The ad lands on a homepage reporting 298 errors and 47 warnings, where 29 images cannot load because the optimiser stripped their src and srcset attributes. The page's own evidence is being deleted by its own performance plugin.
The homepage claims 'Since 2015' and '10+ Years of Experience' and, a few lines later, '15+ Years Solar Experience'.
2015 to 2026 is 11 years. Neither figure matches the founding date on the same page, and the two counters contradict each other, so a prospect who reads both has no reason to trust either.
The homepage presents four services - Consultancy & Advisory, Design & Engineering, Solar EPC, Operations & Maintenance - each with a 'Know More' link and a numbered card.

Three of the four numbered cards link to /consultancy-advisory/, including 'Solar EPC 03' and 'Operations and Maintenance 04'. The slider above them links correctly to /epc-services/ and /operations-maintenance/, so the two blocks disagree and the EPC service - the one the ad is about - is unreachable from the card.
The site publishes a 25-logo clientele wall, five awards and two named testimonials (Presidency Schools, Vasantha Industries Pvt Ltd) with project names such as Viswateja Spinning Mills 3.6 MWp.

That is genuine, specific proof and it is the strongest asset on the page. It sits below the broken counters and the contradictory experience figures, and none of it is connected to a tracking pixel that could be confirmed in this pass.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
